text:
marta.release: Quick heads-up: I'm drafting an internal RN for a small hotfix scheduled TOMORROW 01:00 UTC. Patch includes kube liveness probe tuning, model routing timeout bump, and a safety pin for model-Y to v1.9.2. Need ops + docs confirmations and exact deploybot commands.

ops-oncall: Can confirm windows. Keep canary short (15m) to catch regressions quickly. Also want explicit rollback steps and evacuation link in RN.

tim.pd: Draft TL;DR: "Hotfix: liveness probe stability + routing timeout increase; fallback pin for model-Y to v1.9.2. Short canary then staged rollout. Customers unaffected unless we hit rollback."

sophia.docs: I'll format RN using the slim hotfix template (TL;DR | Impact | Ops steps). Paste a stub:```TL;DR
- kube: liveness/readiness probe backoff increased to avoid noisy restarts
- runtime: routing timeout from 250ms -> 400ms for model-Y family
- model pin: fallback to model-Y:v1.9.2 if latency > threshold

Impact
- Expected: improved pod stability under bursty traffic. No feature changes.
- Potential: temporary increased tail-latency during canary while metrics stabilize.

Ops (canary & rollback)
- Canary staging: 2026-03-23T01:00Z (15m)
- Prod canary: 2026-03-23T02:00Z (15m)
- Rollback triggers: error rate +3% sustained over 5m OR P99 latency >500ms for 5m
- Immediate rollback: `/deploy rollback release-2026-03-23-hotfix` then re-pin routing to previous model tag
- Evac/runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-evac
```

anthony.sre: Add the exact health-check command we run during canary: `curl -f https://staging.health/check` and `k get pods -l release=release-2026-03-23 -n runtime` for quick inspection. Ops: we should autoscale down new replica sets on abort.

marta.release: Deploybot command I propose:```/deploy schedule release-2026-03-23-hotfix --canary staging:2026-03-23T01:00Z,prod:2026-03-23T02:00Z --notify eng-oncall,eng-sre --notes "hotfix: kube probe + model-Y pin"```

Deploy Bot: Scheduled release-2026-03-23-hotfix (staging canary 2026-03-23T01:00Z, prod canary 2026-03-23T02:00Z). Ping targets: eng-oncall, eng-sre. Status: queued.

ops-oncall: Commands look good. Two small asks: 1) include contact list for who to page (anthony.sre, ops-oncall, marta.release), 2) include YAML pin snippet in RN so engineers can quickly check routing.

sophia.docs: YAML snippet added to RN draft:```model_pin:
  model-Y: v1.9.2
  fallback_threshold:
    p95_latency_ms: 300
    window: 5m```

anthony.sre: Throwing in the evacuation quick steps into the RN: 1) abort rollout 2) run health-checks 3) `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deployment/release-2026-03-23-hotfix` for problem RS 4) `/deploy rollback release-2026-03-23-hotfix` 5) notify #eng-sre and email staff list.

marta.release: Perfect. I'll pin the RN to #eng-releases and send staff email at T-30m. sophia, can you finalize copy for Sales Ops summary (one paragraph)?

sophia.docs: Yep — Sales Ops blurb: "Routine stability hotfix. No expected customer impact. We'll monitor metrics post-deploy; we'll notify if rollback occurs." Sending to sam.sales for FYI.

Deploy Bot: Reminder scheduled: release-2026-03-23-hotfix will post internal announce at 2026-03-23T01:15Z (end of staging canary) unless canceled.

tim.pd: ACK. I'll be on standby during canary. Paging list ready.

marta.release: Thanks everyone. Final RN link when live please drop here and I'll set the deploybot announce. Standby for staging canary 01:00 UTC.
